name: NCT Alliance Berhad
summary: NCT Alliance Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development business in Malaysia. The company develops residential and commercial properties. It also operates as a general and renovation works contractor, as well as offers provision of project management activities. The company was formerly known as Grand-Flo Berhad and changed its name to NCT Alliance Berhad in July 2021. NCT Alliance Berhad was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Puchong, Malaysia. NCT Alliance Berhad operates as a subsidiary of YBG Yap Consolidated Sdn. Bhd.
